categories.name: Chest
categories.description: Chest training primarily targets the pectoralis major and minor. It is essential for upper body pushing strength and creates a balanced, powerful physique.
categories.howTo: Keep your shoulder blades retracted (squeezed back and down). Control the weight during the descent and exhale as you push. Focus on the squeeze at the top without locking elbows.
categories.benefit: Improved pushing power, better posture, and high metabolic activation.

categories.name: Back
categories.description: Back training involves the latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and traps. A strong back protects your spine and is the foundation for almost every other major lift.
categories.howTo: Think about pulling with your elbows rather than your hands. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement and maintain a neutral spine.
categories.benefit: Creates a strong 'V-taper' frame, improves spinal health, and balances posture.

categories.name: Legs
categories.description: Leg day covers the quads, hamstrings, and glutes. These are the largest muscles in the body, meaning leg training burns the most calories and releases the most growth hormones.
categories.howTo: Keep your feet flat and core tight. Ensure your knees stay in line with your toes and don't cave inward. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
categories.benefit: Massive functional strength, explosive power, and the highest calorie burn of any workout.
